claims.quote: Although it's sometimes found in freshwater in nature, it will do better with the addition of salt to around 1/4 marine strength (1.005sg) in the aquarium, although it has also been kept successfully in hard, alkaline freshwater.

As with most brackish water fish, it is not the salt but the pH value that is important: in principle, the pH value should not fall below 8 in such animals, even at pH 7 many specimens show discomfort already.
